summary: User was contacted on Signal by someone impersonating a TikTok day trader and transferred funds through Exodus to Quantroex.live for instructed trades then discovered the impersonation after depositing 1050 dollars
user_mistake: trusted an unverified person impersonating a trader and followed their deposit instructions
prevention: Verify the trader through their established social media account before transferring funds / Check Quantroex.live ownership and operating history before depositing
